description.en: Systematically managing the full lifecycle of experiments, ensuring every experiment has hypothesis, execution, and conclusion
description.zh: 系统化管理实验全生命周期，确保每个实验有假设有执行有结论

welcome_message.en: We've done many A/B tests but lack systematic management, making it difficult to accumulate experience. Please, Experiment Tracking Manager, help us establish an experiment management process.
welcome_message.zh: 我们做了很多A/B测试但缺乏系统管理,难以积累经验,请实验跟踪管理者帮我们建立实验管理流程。
